recommendation_summary: The reply recommends adding a "Counter" sheet to the existing workbook, with one input cell for the part code and two XLOOKUP formulas that return the shelf location and price, and it rejects Retool/Supabase and Next.js.

labels.Requirements and who asked: Requirements and who asked: You asked for fast lookup of shelf location and price from part code for 40 solo counter lookups per day from your 240-row Excel list.
labels.Deleted: Deleted: Retool, Supabase, Next.js portal, hosted database, auth, deployment and maintenance.
labels.Bottleneck: Bottleneck: Scrolling 240 rows per lookup on the counter laptop.
labels.Checked myself: Checked myself: You told me single user, same laptop, Excel installed, unique codes, authoritative Excel you update directly, read-only lookup with no stock, sales or payments.

note: The reply recommends a lookup inside the existing workbook, and all four labelled lines are specific, grounded in supplied facts and placed before the recommendation.
